description: Elections Commission - Amended Notice for Local Authorities in Nuwara Eliya District (Order under Section 38(3) of the L. A. E. O.)
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with the postponement of local authority elections, including the announcement of a new election date (25th April 2023) and references to the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It contains a schedule of specific local government bodies affected. This falls squarely under "Election announcements and schedules" in the Elections Gazettes category (Type 7).
